assessments.summary: The supplied argument establishes the finite-grid cardinality reductions by posterior representation and Carathéodory compression, proves the reflection-compatible reduction, derives the exact Q0 parameterization, verifies the coercive bound B(G,K) >= V_0(g,k) >= max{F(g),F(k)}, obtains both Q0 infima equal to c, and derives the stated midpoint window. The required 30-row definitions, optimization order, and comparison V_Q(G,K) <= B(G,K) are supplied by the declared dependency.
scopeQualifications: Validity is relative to the exact accepted private-message 30-row system supplied by the dependency.
The result applies to finite posterior grids and finite-output receivers only.
No continuum receiver-cardinality bound or grid-limit interchange is established.
No full-functional reflected-optimality or symmetrization assertion for arbitrary receiver pairs is established.
No new numerical sum-capacity bound or independent capacity-converse interpretation is established.
